status: Proposed marketing campaign accompanying the accepted November offering. Headline, budget and commercial claims remain subject to final joint review.
headline: A clear view of your next design.
subheadline: Autodesk AutoCAD on Logix Artemis PRO. From drawing to plotted output.
continuity: NCC introduced Pointy ideas with a solid point. COMDEX demonstrates the professional work enabled by the mouse, displays and independent software.
primary_audiences: Small engineering and architectural practices evaluating desktop CAD
Specialist computer dealers and CAD resellers
secondary_audiences: Existing Artemis owners evaluating a professional upgrade

messages.proof: Native 800x600 drawing area on the 17-inch screen, four shades selected from 16 levels, static CAD palette and demonstrated line quality.

messages.message: Keep commands and drawing in view
messages.proof: Colour command/status display alongside the dedicated drawing screen, with explicit keyboard/mouse focus.

messages.message: Take the drawing beyond the screen
messages.proof: Save, reopen, exchange and plot the same test drawing; verify coordinates and output scale.

messages.message: Buy an application with a supported platform
messages.proof: Autodesk application support and Logix hardware/integration support, qualified configurations, dealer training and a clear upgrade route.

script.action: Open a representative mechanical or floor-plan drawing from disk; show the command screen and drawing screen together.
Create and edit supported lines/arcs using typed coordinates and mouse input. Use only commands present in the qualified AutoCAD 1.0 build.
Pan/zoom and compare ordinary versus antialiased line rendering at the same scale. State measured redraw behaviour; do not promise arbitrary real-time performance.
Save and reopen the drawing, demonstrate tested exchange, and show the resulting plot.
Explain complete-system and existing-owner upgrade routes, support ownership, and book an evaluation.

hero_demo.plotter_timing: Run a small live plot; disclose any larger pre-plotted sample as such. Do not imply a long plot completes within a short demonstration.
hero_demo.proof_policy: Use a fixed published test drawing and configuration. Distinguish line-rendering smoothness from numerical geometry accuracy; no unsupported competitor speed comparison.

booth_zones.name: Live drawing theatre
booth_zones.purpose: Repeat the 12-minute workflow at scheduled times with Autodesk and Logix presenters.

booth_zones.name: Hands-on design desks
booth_zones.purpose: Supervised trials using supplied or screened customer drawings; gather task-specific feedback.

booth_zones.name: Dealer and customer consultation
booth_zones.purpose: Qualified configuration, training, storage/plotter needs and written quotation.

booth_zones.name: Developer partnership desk
booth_zones.purpose: Explain the Autodesk collaboration and Team Edition development workflow; keep this secondary to CAD.

press_kit: Joint Logix/Autodesk announcement and named support responsibilities
Accurate 128 KiB/four-shade/17-inch specification and compatibility table
Sample drawing, photograph of the actual display and plotted output
Measured configuration-specific results with reproducible test procedure
Availability/acceptance status and separate hardware/software price sheet once approved

schedule.activity: Use the existing Autodesk beta programme for reference workflows and qualified customer feedback; no second overlapping beta event.
Train selected dealers, rehearse the demo, confirm the plotter driver and prepare press materials.
Invite technical press and qualified prospects; offer scheduled demos and customer-drawing evaluations.
Joint presentation, supervised trials and dealer meetings; accept orders only against explicit configuration and delivery terms.
Telephone/postal follow-up within five business days, regional evaluations, delivery acceptance and early-customer training.
Publish approved customer case studies and measured support findings; review conversion and product defects.

call_to_action: Bring a drawing. See it on Artemis. Take home the plot.
commercial_tactics: Offer a booked drawing evaluation and written configuration quote.
Publish the existing-owner upgrade route alongside the complete reference system.
Make introductory training scope explicit and cost it before promising inclusion.
Maintain Autodesk branding and non-exclusive licensing; no unapproved AutoCAD discount or free-bundle claim.
measurement: Qualified demonstrations with named organisation, workload and next step
Evaluations completed and customer acceptance findings
Written quotes and conversion to delivered, accepted installations
Dealers trained and reference configurations qualified
Support workload, defects, file-exchange problems and plot accuracy

budget.status: Proposal allocation only; dollar envelope to be costed after booth, staffing, hardware and Autodesk co-marketing terms are agreed.
budget.accounting: Separate from the $253000 NCC campaign provision. Credit shared staff and reused demo equipment; do not charge capital twice or invent sales uplift. Team Edition adoption subsidy remains separate unit economics.

claim_limits: Do not promise 16 simultaneous shades at 800x600x2bpp.
Advertise 60 Hz only after the selected HD17H derivative is qualified.
No claim that a binary TTL/ECL amplifier becomes grayscale solely through a digital controller.
No guaranteed June price for the expanded November hardware revision.
Historical AutoCAD 1.0 shipped in December 1982; November Artemis readiness is a deliberate alternate-history target.
